notes: This sample preserves upstream identity for Epic 32 adaptation work.
The compose shape is derived from the official PostgreSQL Docker image documentation; the Websoft9 docker-library entry is used as a secondary reference only.
PostgreSQL is a single-service application: the server serves the TCP wire protocol (5432) and stores data. No separate database service is modeled.
The Websoft9 reference includes an optional database-backup-service sidecar (profiles: backup); it is intentionally omitted from the normalized template.
The first pass stores source metadata rather than a full upstream file mirror.
